sources.title: GitHub - shamazharikh/qwen-rlcd: Jev-style calibrated decision model ...
sources.snippet: A prototype of a "System One" decision model, inspired by TypeSafe AI's Jev. The model takes a state (context) and a set of typed questions. In a single forward pass it returns calibrated probability distributions over a fixed set of answers, with no text generation.

sources.snippet: We're on a journey to advance and democratize artificial intelligence through open source and open science.

sources.title: Jev-Style-Qwen3.5-2B-Decision (GGUF) - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: A Jev-style decision model: it does not write text. Give it a state, a question and a list of options, and it returns the decision with calibrated probabilities from a single token position.

sources.title: Jev AI Model (TypeSafe) — Typed System One Decisions
sources.snippet: Jev is TypeSafe AI's System One model: it returns a choice, score, or yes/no probability instead of chat. The hosted API is open as of 21 September 2026. $0.042 per 1M input tokens, output free.

sources.title: GitHub - bnsd55/jevmlx: Jev-style parallel constrained decisions for ...
sources.snippet: Jev-style parallel constrained decisions for any MLX model on Apple Silicon. Typed, schema-valid JSON in one forward pass. - bnsd55/jevmlx
